analysis.reason: 최근 4거래일 연속 하락세(-7.67% → -5.44% → -4.09% → -2.26%)로 RSI 36.8까지 하락했으나 과매도 탈출 실패. MACD 히스토그램은 -1312.3374로 악화되며 약세 수렴 중. ADX 9.9로 추세 형성 미약, 5일 저가 지지선 92,965원 부근에서 횡보 중. 변동성 ATR 7,100원 대비 손절폭 1.3배(9,230원) 설정 시 진입가 93,620원 기준 손절 84,390원, 목표가 102,850원(손익비 1.5 이상) 설정 가능하나, 추세 부재 및 RSI 약세로 매수 진입은 보류.
analysis.reasonEn: The price has declined for the last 4 consecutive sessions (-7.67% to -5.44% to -4.09% to -2.26%), pushing RSI down to 36.8 but failing to exit oversold territory. MACD histogram is worsening at -1312.3374, indicating bearish convergence. ADX at 9.9 suggests weak trend formation, and the price is consolidating near the 5-day low support of 92,965 KRW. While a buy entry at 93,620 KRW with a stop loss at 84,390 KRW (1.3x ATR of 7,100 KRW) and target at 102,850 KRW (risk/reward >= 1.5) is technically possible, the lack of trend and weak RSI signal a cautious approach, thus deferring a buy entry.
